fusions.name: Sticky Tongue
fusions.desc: Flicks your tongue at the first enemy in reach and deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Landing
fusions.desc: You drop your full weight onto the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Each has a 50% chance to be [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried in Mud
fusions.desc: You sink still into the mud. For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
